banner.c and banner-data.js in this directory are derived from:

  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/freebsd/freebsd-src/main/usr.bin/banner/banner.c
  commit 0b8224d1cc9dc6c9778ba04a75b2c8d47e5d7481 (main, 2023-11-24), fetched 2026-09-23.

banner.c is the upstream source, kept verbatim for reference/audit; it is not
loaded at runtime. banner-data.js is a hand-port of its two data arrays
(asc_ptr[128], data_table[9271]) plus, separately, this project's own toys.js
implements the run-length decoding algorithm (line ~1100-1155 of banner.c)
in JS -- see toys.js for that logic. Only the *data* is vendored here.

Verified: toys.js's JS port of the decode algorithm, run against
banner-data.js, was diffed (trailing whitespace trimmed) against this
machine's real /usr/bin/banner output for several cases and matched
byte-for-byte, including:
  banner -w 60 HI
  banner -w 40 42
  banner -w 50 Go
  banner -w 80 "A'B"
  banner -w 30 Z
and undefined-character handling (banner -w 40 '<>') was confirmed to match
the real binary's behavior: it refuses to print anything and instead
reports "the character '<' is not in my character set" for each character
not in asc_ptr (real banner's BUGS section: "< > [ ] \ ^ _ { } | ~" are
not defined -- confirmed against the real binary on this Mac).
